description: This file exports several functions and types related to QMD/session/query helpers used by the memory engine, acting as an index or aggregator for various modules in the project.

classes.name: SessionFileEntry
classes.description: Type representing a session file entry used within the session management system.

methods.name: extractKeywords
methods.description: Function to extract keywords from a query or text.

methods.name: isQueryStopWordToken
methods.description: Function to determine if a token is a stop word in query expansion.

methods.name: buildSessionEntry
methods.description: Creates a new session file entry.

methods.name: listSessionFilesForAgent
methods.description: Lists session files associated with a specific agent.

methods.name: sessionPathForFile
methods.description: Generates the filesystem path for a session file.

methods.name: parseQmdQueryJson
methods.description: Parses a QMD query JSON object into a result structure.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChannel
methods.description: Derives the scope channel from given parameters.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChatType
methods.description: Derives the chat type scope for QMD.

methods.name: isQmdScopeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific QMD scope is permitted.

methods.name: checkQmdBinaryAvailability
methods.description: Verifies the availability of the QMD binary.

methods.name: resolveCliSpawnInvocation
methods.description: Resolves the CLI command invocation for QMD processes.

methods.name: runCliCommand
methods.description: Executes a CLI command related to QMD.
